changes.description: `--cloud` and `--repo` now work in non-interactive runs, which print the cloud session id to resume or delete it
Report program status to supporting terminals with OSC 7501; opt out with `KIRO_NO_PROGRAM_STATUS`
[V3] Write approvals let you allow a custom folder at session, workspace, or user scope
[V3] `/workflow run` opens a confirmation form with a plan preview before a workflow starts
[V3] Proactive, Explanatory, and Learning output styles in `/settings display`
[V3] Workflow coding, planning, and design steps can use Powers
[V3] Workflow design steps can use configured MCP servers
Startup "What's new" now introduces memory, with next steps for your engine and memory setting
[V3] The Always Allow scope page now shows the selected scope, with `s` to cycle between them
Subagents spawned from a V2 session now follow that session's model fallback configuration
[V3] A workflow step's session opens on its task instead of a copy of the parent conversation
[V3] Creating a workflow from a prompt shows its plan for your approval before any step runs
[V3] Kiro CLI no longer bundles the `sharp` and libvips native image libraries
[V3] Running workflows accept plain-language changes to their remaining steps
[V3] Saved-session lists refresh without blocking on periodic directory scans
[V3] Workflow review loops pause after two rejected reviews and ask you how to continue
[V3] `/chat save` to a non-`.zip` name now says the file is a zip session archive
[V3] `/chat load` explains when a session archive was altered after saving
[V3] Non-interactive `--resume-id` of a cloud session now resumes it instead of starting an empty local session
MCP OAuth links now disappear when their server connects, with the server named in the toast
Plain-text non-interactive runs now explain why a turn was cancelled or refused, or a session could not start
Non-interactive runs exit nonzero when stdout is closed instead of finishing the turn
Choosing None in the V2 `/model` fallback picker now turns fallback off instead of keeping the vendor default
The `/model` fallback row names the vendor default that would answer a refusal when no target is configured
A V2 crew whose stage cannot start now fails with that stage's error instead of waiting forever
[V3] A paused step in a parallel workflow branch finishes when it reports success or failure
[V3] A turn no longer ends early when the model spends its whole output budget on reasoning
[V3] Buffered workflow messages survive an agent restart
[V3] Command approval checks shell syntax for the shell that runs the command, including fish
[V3] Completed workflow steps can send follow-up information to their parent
[V3] MCP servers from an organization MCP registry use the registry's `oauth` and `oauthScopes` settings
[V3] Oversized images retry at the provider's size limit instead of failing the turn
[V3] Resumed sessions show their saved model and effort before the model list loads
[V3] Workflow pause messages no longer say a run will resume on its own
Mermaid flowchart, sequence, state and ER diagrams are drawn as terminal art in chat
[V3] Non-interactive runs apply saved compaction and `toolSearch` settings like interactive sessions
Prompts with `chat.disableWrap` on or in lite session panes no longer copy with two leading spaces
[V3] Herdr shows a session as blocked while a permission or question prompt is waiting
Model fallback now handles refusals that return no response text
Compaction no longer saves the model's refusal as the conversation summary
[V3] `/sandbox` setup on Windows no longer fails where policy blocks running programs from the temp folder
`/changelog` shows each entry on its own line
IAM Identity Center sign-in now works in isolated AWS partitions
[V3] Workflow recipe text can no longer emit terminal escape sequences in `/workflow`
